verdict.rationale: Browserbase runs real browser sessions with auto-waits and offers a fetch capability that converts any URL into HTML. Together these imply rendered-HTML output for dynamic pages. However, no evidence states that JavaScript-heavy SPAs are fully rendered before the HTML is returned, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: explicit documentation that JS/SPA content is executed and rendered before HTML is returned, documented wait/render-completion controls for the fetch output, independent or hands-on corroboration of SPA rendering.

support.subject: As a developer, I can render JavaScript-heavy single-page applications and get the fully rendered HTML
